When dried at 105° for 2 hours, it contains one molecule of water of hydration or is anhy- drous. Soluble 1 in 20 of water, 1 in 2.4 of alcohol, 1 in 2.9 of chloroform, and 1 in 5000 of ether; very soluble in methyl alco- hol. pH of a 3% solution in water is between 6.5 and 7.5. Store in airtight containers. Profile Denatonium benzoate is used where an intensely bitter taste is required for medicinal or industrial purposes and as a partial de- naturant for alcohol in toiletries.
